text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack, rattle... Clack...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's snowing even harder... There's normally
a beautiful view of the
stars here. I'm not
sure how tonight will turn out though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all that snow. When did it
pile up so high?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It started coming down nearly thirty
minutes ago. You really lose
yourself in
that game of yours.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: 'Cause you...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Nothin'. I was just thinking how the
snow's white as your hair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't be silly. But never mind. If it
gets any worse, it'll start
snowing down the
whole mountain. And if that happens...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket won't be able to make it up here,
even if she's feeling better.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her safety won't be guaranteed... But even
if we say it's dangerous,
she'll likely try to
come anyway. What can I do...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just forget Ticket for a while. There's
no use getting upset over
stuff we can't
control.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But Ticket—if she...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She isn't struggling this hard just to let a
little snow stop her. I'm sure
she already
got better by screaming "Sickness is all in
the mind!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And I really don't wanna give this present by myself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, aren't you the one who said she'd
make a miracle happen?
Don't chicken out
in your beliefs now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I've got such wonderful friends.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? How so?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both you and Ticket always show me a
completely different
perspective than my
own. Like just now with you, Taishin.
Having you
here is so reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're never shy to tell me your opinion,
and you're incredibly
considerate. Are you
feeling bad that I've been preparing things
all
by myself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then let me tell you what you were
about to say earlier. " 'Cause
you won't let
me help at all, so all I can do is play
games."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you really are kind. But some
people would rather please their
friends
by taking care of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Put more explicitly, simply having you two be here is enough for me. So I may have been overenthusiastic about doing everything myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Shall we call Ticket? I'll tell her that we're
all ready here, and to take
her time
coming.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Like you know me, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle... Clack, clack...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Me? No. It's just the wind outside. The
snow's getting even heavier...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oguri! Weren't you cold outside? Just
hold on a little. We'll have
some piping
hot food ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay... Thank you! I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I am excited, but... this isn't good. I just... I don't have a present!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find any reindeer, and now that I
think about it, I don't even
have a beard...
Maybe I can't become Santa in time. I
don't know...

text_block_list.name: Child Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's no star?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, er... It's about the star to decorate our
tree. The children made it
specially for
tonight, so we were taking great care in
carrying it over,
but...

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
It's a blizzard out there right now. And,
well, it seems the road up
here has been
closed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Meaning... we have no star...

text_block_list.name: Child Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Can't we do anything?! You'd really like
the star, Oguri! It's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's a terrible shame, but cars can't
make it up here with the
road closed. We'll
just have to wait until tomorrow for her to
see the
star.

text_block_list.name: Child Fan A
text_block_list.text:
But the star's for tonight's party. I really
thought it'd make Oguri feel
better...

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa there, let's not mention that.

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text:
Gee... Looks like our surprise fell apart...
I'm sorry. But I'm sure once
the party
begins, the kids will feel better—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Head Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll go... and get the star.
